InvDatabase._comment: Production INV database (READ ONLY). Set ConnectionString via environment variable InvDatabase__ConnectionString, user secrets, or an untracked appsettings.*.local.json. Never commit credentials. Never use 'sa'.

Features._comment: ExternalReadOnly=true is set ONLY by the anonymous external (DDNS) IIS site via Features__ExternalReadOnly; it refuses every write server-side. The internal Windows-authenticated application leaves it false.
